messages.author: aedc8ef8f23b5716
messages.subject: Re: determine the size of a particular node without specifying any rule..
parts:
On Jun 21, 2011, at 2:31 PM, Burak Kutlu wrote:

> Is it possible? [to determine the size of a particular node without specifying any rule]
> thanks!
> -burak

Hi Burak,

Do you mean to -set- the size of a node without a rule? If so, then yes. There is a rich set of set[Node|Edge][vizprop]Direct methods.

For node size, see http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net/versions/current/methods/setNodeSizeDirect.html

If you want to know how big a node currently is, we can't do that yet. Jan -- got any ideas?

Cheers,

- Paul

parts:
Hi Paul,

Cytoscape can return the width and height of a node through the CyNodeView class. I could implement this in the next version of CyRPC.

Cheers,

Jan
